_designNotes.buildState: Rooms, graph and scene specs written by _scratch/build_scenario.py (2026-11-19; the summit car park added 2026-11-20): the graded pair's volcano island (lair + observatory) in Staff Only's year, in morning light. Day one: the monitoring station (hub: bulletin board = deliver, S-curve board = instrument, day ledger = dataset explorer, notice case -> Staff Only) and the footpath up the flank to seismo_hut (L1), gas_vent (L2), crater_rim (L3). Day two: the station's truck drives up to the summit car park (arrival, no task), whose observatory front door opens into the plate archive (hub: second bulletin board, tally board, plate cabinet, notice case -> Good Seeing) and plate_store (L1), measuring_engine (L2), dome (L3). The truck door to the car park is hidden until state.day_two is true (Wednesday). Live scenario: tasks are dealt by the live-class server (authoring_v2/live_class/pool/watch.json); the book's practice pool is solo/pool.json. No codec id, no escape, ungraded. Music: the parent scenarios have no track yet. Art: every room from text + skeleton, the station first.

worldPlatePrompt: One continuous single-frame view at sunrise from a little above a small volcano monitoring station high on the steep flank of a volcanic island: a tidy gravel yard cut into black cinder with a low whitewashed hut, a slim radio mast and a white four-wheel-drive truck parked by the yard's gateway, a mountain road winding below, a stepped footpath with a rope handrail climbing past a squat stone hut to the level edge of the crater's shelf where a thin white plume of steam rises, and over the shelf's skyline, small with distance, the tall pale stacks of a geothermal plant on the crater's far rim. Low warm gold sunlight from the east-south-east over a deep blue ocean, long cool shadows, a clear sky. Photorealistic. No people, no animals, no text, no night lights.
coverPrompt: Minimalist stylised thumbnail poster: the bold silhouette of a steep volcano's summit with one small observatory dome on its top and a thin plume of steam from its flank, against a huge low rising sun. One bold, simple, high-contrast silhouette that reads at thumbnail size; flat limited palette of deep blue sky, dark silhouette and one warm amber glow of the sunrise. Strong negative space, soft film grain. Square. No people, no text.
story: It is morning on the volcano island, and the monitoring station needs its calls made: yes or no, from the readings. Climb the footpath to a task at the seismometer hut (one call), the fumarole (two) or the crater rim (three), build the model in R, and choose your answer to fill the calls you carry. Bring each load back down and clip it to the morning bulletin board.
